buildCommand: npx expo export --platform web && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='.vercel/output/config.json';if(fs.existsSync(p)){const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));if(!c.routes)c.routes=[];const hasFs=c.routes.some(r=>r.handle==='filesystem');if(!hasFs)c.routes.push({handle:'filesystem'});if(!c.routes.find(r=>r.src&&r.src.startsWith('/(.*)'))){c.routes.push({src:'/(.*)',dest:'/index.html'});}fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(c,null,2));console.log('Patched .vercel/output/config.json with catch-all route');}else{console.log('No .vercel/output/config.json found, vercel.json routes will be used.');}"
